lines.text: The Spirit of the LORD departed from Saul, and his servants suggested finding someone to play the harp skillfully.
Saul told his servants to find a good player, and one servant named a son of Eli of Bethlehem.
Saul sent messengers to Jesse, who sent David to Saul with bread, a skin of wine, and a young goat.
Saul loved David very much, and David became his cupbearer, so Saul asked Jesse to let David stay.
Whenever the spirit from God came upon Saul, David played his harp, and Saul found relief.
